purpose: Layer 0 — build the project model (language, build profile, entry points, dependency graph, unanalyzed units) for the analysis target.
summaryPrompt:
Write the L0 project model as a markdown document.

Original Goal: {goal}

Sections (use these headers):
## Target
## Language & toolchain (version, build profile, integer overflow policy, pointer width)
## Units in scope (table: unit · file · lines · entry point? · criticality)
## Dependency graph (which in-scope units call which, plus external calls needing effect summaries)
## Existing evidence (tests, docstrings, asserts, contracts that can seed specs)
## Unanalyzed (constructs or units the front end must refuse to model, with reasons)
## Open questions for the human

Be concrete: cite file paths and line numbers. Never guess the overflow policy — if the profile is unknown, say so and list both.
name: SubPlan
